name: Tielmes (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and red with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tielmes (a saint's figure on white and a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Tielmes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
